title: Compositional Concepts Erasing: Disentangling Object-Style via Domain Manifold Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2610.14514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models pose significant risks regarding the generation of illicit content and copyright violations. This has catalyzed the development of machine unlearning to erase harmful concepts or copyrighted styles from a model's generative repertoire without compromising its general performance. However, previous unlearning approaches on diffusion models have largely focused on either object-level or style-level removal and failed to address the challenge of object-style combination unlearning. At the same time, multiple unlearning requests often lead to catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU), which uses an EMA-updated feature proxy extracted from intermediate diffusion features to represent the retained target-object direction. translated_title: 组合概念擦除：通过域流形遗忘实现对象与风格的解耦
translated_abstract: 扩散模型在生成非法内容和侵犯版权方面存在重大风险。这推动了机器遗忘技术的发展，以便在不损害模型整体性能的前提下，从模型的生成能力中擦除有害概念或受版权保护的风格。然而，以往针对扩散模型的遗忘方法大多只关注对象级别或风格级别的删除，未能解决对象-风格组合遗忘这一挑战。同时，多个遗忘请求往往会导致灾难性遗忘。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了域流形遗忘（DMU）方法，该方法使用从中间扩散特征中提取的EMA更新的特征代理来表示需要保留的目标对象方向。作为一种轻量级的对象估计表示，DMU能够在保留对象核心特征的同时，选择性地遗忘特定对象中域相关的组成部分。
tldr: 提出了域流形遗忘（DMU）方法，利用EMA更新的轻量级特征代理表示保留的对象方向，实现了扩散模型中对象-风格组合概念的选择性擦除，同时避免多个遗忘请求导致的灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: Proposes Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU), which uses a lightweight EMA-updated feature proxy to represent the retained target-object direction, enabling selective unlearning of object-style combinations in diffusion models while preventing catastrophic forgetting from multiple unlearning requests.
